PORTA.gloss: an aperture or hole that opens into a bodily cavity
PORTA.definition: An aperture or hole that opens into a bodily cavity.
PORTA.example: The orifice into the aorta from the lower left chamber of the heart.

PART.gloss: something determined in relation to something that includes it
PART.definition: Something determined in relation to something that includes it.
PART.example: He wanted to feel a part of something bigger than himself.

PORT.gloss: a place where people and merchandise can enter or leave a country
PORT.definition: A place (seaport or airport) where people and merchandise can enter or leave a country.

TRAP.gloss: a device in which something can be caught and penned
TRAP.definition: A device in which something (usually an animal) can be caught and penned.

ATOP.gloss: on, to, or at the top
ATOP.definition: On, to, or at the top.

TARO.gloss: edible starchy tuberous root of taro plants
TARO.definition: Edible starchy tuberous root of taro plants.

TOP.example: The mower cuts off the tops of the grass.

ART.definition: The products of human creativity; works of art collectively.

PRO.gloss: an athlete who plays for pay
PRO.definition: An athlete who plays for pay.

POT.gloss: metal or earthenware cooking vessel that is usually round and deep
POT.definition: Metal or earthenware cooking vessel that is usually round and deep; often has a handle and lid.

TAP.gloss: cut a female screw thread with a tap
TAP.definition: Cut a female screw thread with a tap.

PAT.gloss: pat or squeeze fondly or playfully, especially under the chin
PAT.definition: Pat or squeeze fondly or playfully, especially under the chin.

RAT.gloss: any of various long-tailed rodents similar to but larger than a mouse
RAT.definition: Any of various long-tailed rodents similar to but larger than a mouse.

PAR.gloss: the standard number of strokes set for each hole on a golf course, or for the entire…
PAR.definition: (golf) the standard number of strokes set for each hole on a golf course, or for the entire course.

RAP.gloss: a reproach for some lapse or misdeed
RAP.definition: A reproach for some lapse or misdeed.
RAP.example: He took the blame for it.

OPT.gloss: select as an alternative over another
OPT.definition: Select as an alternative over another.
OPT.example: I always choose the fish over the meat courses in this restaurant.
